title.zh: v2.0.91 界面文字读不清的问题，现在有一条会失败的检查
title.en: v2.0.91 Unreadable UI Text Now Fails the Build

highlights.zh: **全量扫了一遍 `src/` 里 66 个硬编码文字色**，逐个按 `--panel #121317` 算 WCAG 对比度：10 个低于 3:1，再 8 个低于 4.5:1 的正文线。计划里点名的只有其中两处。**52 处、11 个文件**换成早就存在的 `text-dim` 语义色，另把四处彩色胶囊调过线（红/粉底 `#ff5964`、`#ec4899`，以及钢琴卷帘黑键上的音名）。
highlights.en: **Swept all 66 hard-coded text colours in `src/`** and measured each against `--panel #121317`: 10 fell below 3:1 and 8 more below the 4.5:1 body-text line. The plan named two of them. **52 occurrences across 11 files** moved onto the `text-dim` token that already existed, and four tinted chips were adjusted to clear the floor (the red/pink `#ff5964` and `#ec4899` fills, and the piano roll's black-key pitch names).

highlights.zh: **新增 `readabilityAudit.test.ts`**：读源码找出每一个 `text-[#hex]`，按它自己那条 class 串里声明的背景算对比度，低于 4.5:1 就报出**引入它的那一行**和比值。毫秒级，不截图。把 `#4a4e58` 写回项目里任意一个文件，实测失败并报出 `2.23:1`。
highlights.en: **New `readabilityAudit.test.ts`**: it reads the source, takes every `text-[#hex]`, resolves the background its own class string declares, and reports **the line that introduced it** when the ratio is under 4.5:1. Milliseconds, no screenshots. Writing `#4a4e58` back into any file in the project fails it with `2.23:1`.

highlights.zh: **扫描器补上了两件容易搞错的事**：带变体的字色（`group-hover:text-[#0a0b0d]`）只对**同变体**的背景负责，否则正确的悬停镂空会被报成隐形字；半透明底要先**合成**再算（`bg-white/[0.06]`、`bg-[#ec4899]/20`，而且 Tailwind 的透明度有 `/20`、`/[0.06]`、`/[6%]` 三种写法）。时间线上那个「6% 白胶囊里的灰字」曾被我误报，它真实是 5.23:1。
highlights.en: **The scanner learned the two things it had wrong**: a variant-gated ink (`group-hover:text-[#0a0b0d]`) answers only to that same variant's surface — otherwise a correct hover knockout reads as invisible text; and a translucent surface has to be **composited** before measuring (`bg-white/[0.06]`, `bg-[#ec4899]/20`, in all three Tailwind alpha spellings). The timeline's grey-on-6%-white chip was a false alarm of mine: it really is 5.23:1.
